title: Pharmacy Services Questions: Resident Pharmacy-Profile Reduction on Respite Medication Setup
content:
**Rule.** For the medication setup charge of a stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement, the resident pharmacy-profile reduction is twenty percent (20 percent) for a guest whose active Larkspur independent living residency began at least twenty-four whole months (24 whole months) before the current date, ten percent (10 percent) for a guest whose active residency began fewer than twenty-four whole months before, and nothing for any other guest.

## Questions answered

**What does the reduction apply to?** The packaging charge of the medication setup, as it stands; it is taken on that charge and on nothing else in the medication setup charge. The packaging charge is multiplied by 80 percent at 20 percent and by 90 percent at 10 percent.

**Which records decide it?** The guest's Independent Living Residency Agreement in active status and its move-in date; whole months are counted from the move-in date to the current date.

**A resident moved in exactly 24 whole months ago. Which rate applies?** 20 percent; 24 whole months is at least 24.

**A resident moved in 23 whole months ago.** 10 percent.

**A guest's independent living residency is in notice given status or vacated.** Nothing; the residency is not active.

## Summary

| Active Independent Living Residency Agreement | Whole months since move-in | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| Held | 24 or more | 20 percent |
| Held | Fewer than 24 | 10 percent |
| Not held | — | Nothing |

## Hypothetical illustration

A packaging charge of 120.00 for a resident of 30 whole months is reduced by 20 percent to 96.00.
